== Notes ==
* Makes it easier to maintain [[Critical Defenses]] or [[Critical Agility]].
* Can be used with [[Critical Eye]] to further increase the chance of [[critical hit]]s. The real value to combining these skills is not in the extra damage, but the increased energy return at a mid-level [[Critical Strikes]] rank.
* This is the only Assassin skill that increases attack speed in [[PvP]].
